milestones.title: Original browser execution
milestones.foundation: Guarded translation, checked runtime components, bounded original startup, geometry and input research.
milestones.goal: Play one original minigame through its original menus, round and results entirely in a desktop browser.

criteria.text: Complete original menu → minigame → results → menu three consecutive times, with original-program graphics and audible audio responding to recorded player input, and no unsupported stop or fault.
Execute the game entirely in the browser using compatible player-local content. A privately prepared local module may support this developer gate; end-user browser conversion is required by M2.

Retain source/build/module identities, browser/device details and the input/capture record, with the runtime control/experiment comparison and independent audit. The prototype and standalone component fixtures do not satisfy this gate.

tasks.title: Integrate the original browser round path
tasks.scope: Connect the reached CPU, kernel, graphics, audio and controller requirements through one original round, preserving admission and content guards.

criteria.text: The original title reaches a controllable menu and the selected minigame without replacement rules or scenes.
Reached unsupported behavior stops explicitly; changed CPU/memory/ABI/GPU contracts have targeted checks and independent review.

tasks.title: Verify original browser gameplay and evidence
tasks.scope: Execute and review the repeatable original-menu/round/results scenario on the identified build.

criteria.text: Record three consecutive original rounds with visible output, audible audio and input-driven state changes.
Bind the reports, independent audit, source/module identities and browser/device environment; list all remaining limits.

milestones.title: Complete local game and conversion
milestones.foundation: Limited browser-local XISO/asset preview, known reference identity and reusable prototype input.
milestones.goal: A fresh browser converts the supported player-supplied image and runs the complete original offline game.

criteria.text: From a fresh browser, select the supported image, validate/convert locally and start the original game without a developer toolchain. Exercise unsupported/corrupt input, cancel, clear/reimport and denied/evicted storage; original content never uploads.

Complete the verified catalog/variant/character/arena inventory and original practice, Minigame Frenzy and Tournament flows, with one to four local seats and original CPU behavior. Each required entry passes matching-build reference scenarios; unknown or untested entries remain blockers.

Verify original scoring/ties, rules, timing, movement/collisions, AI, camera/animation/audio and round/tournament progression, plus save/reload after closing and reopening the browser. Retain the full parity matrix and discrepancy record.

tasks.title: Finish browser-local conversion and save recovery
tasks.scope: Connect a compatible player-supplied image to browser-local preparation, original execution and durable local save/reimport handling.

criteria.text: The fresh-browser select → validate → convert → play path works without native helpers or uploaded content.
Unsupported inputs, cancellation, storage denial/eviction, clear/reimport and fresh-session save/reload have observed outcomes.

tasks.title: Accept the complete original offline inventory
tasks.scope: Build and execute the matching-build catalog/mode/reference matrix for the complete original offline game.

criteria.text: Every required game/variant, mode, character and arena is accounted for and exercised; all one-to-four-seat and original CPU cases are covered.
Original rules/presentation, save and full tournament scenarios pass; no required item is accepted as unknown, not reached or approximate.

milestones.title: Online multiplayer and recovery
milestones.foundation: Authority, content locality and four-seat ownership requirements are recorded; online services are unimplemented.
milestones.goal: The original game supports authoritative remote and mixed local/remote matches with recoverable tournament results.

criteria.text: Review and implement the execution/authority/content contract: the server owns outcomes, four total seats have explicit ownership, and original code/assets/RAM/save states remain local. Client-selected winners or a relay-only authority claim fail acceptance.

Pass four-browser and two-local-plus-two-remote cases across the required online catalog. Verify ten consecutive rounds per timing/contact/steering/orb family at 150 ms RTT, 30 ms jitter and 1% loss; music/pattern activities also pass an explicit audio/input fairness case.

Demonstrate disconnect/refresh/reconnect, stale-input handling, lobby-owner transfer and separate match-process recovery. Persist atomic tournament checkpoints/results, restore the committed state and prevent duplicate awards or seat ownership.

tasks.title: Implement authoritative mixed-seat match services
tasks.scope: Resolve the original-runtime/server contract and implement four-seat authority with local-content-safe messages and atomic results.

criteria.text: The reviewed protocol defines authority, identities, compatibility and required state without proprietary data transfer.
Server-owned outcomes, explicit seat ownership and atomic/idempotent tournament result writes are implemented and tested.

tasks.title: Verify online agreement, fairness and recovery
tasks.scope: Exercise remote/mixed parties, every required online catalog entry, impaired networks and recovery boundaries.

criteria.text: Remote and mixed-seat results agree under the defined network/fairness scenarios and representative repeated rounds.
Reconnect, ownership transfer and process recovery restore correct committed state without stuck inputs, duplicate rewards or leaked original content.

milestones.title: Player experience
milestones.foundation: The research app has local menus and owned keyboard/gamepad input; accounts, friends and production lobbies are unimplemented.
milestones.goal: Players can set up their content and controls, find friends, join lobbies and play/rematch through the supported browser interface.

criteria.text: Demonstrate fresh-account/recovery → content readiness → friend request/invite → public/private lobby or join code → ready/start → match → rematch. Verify permissions, privacy/block/report, incompatible content and rejected unauthorized API operations.

Verify per-seat keyboard/gamepad ownership, remapping/conflicts, calibration/prompts and saved preferences on named physical devices. Focus loss, disconnect/reconnect and stale input must produce the defined offline/online behavior without stuck actions.

Exercise keyboard-accessible navigation, visible focus, audio/fullscreen failure handling and quality/accessibility settings. Desktop support comes first; later mobile/touch support must pass these input flows and the M5 device matrix before it is advertised.

tasks.title: Complete accounts, friends and lobby flows
tasks.scope: Deliver account recovery, social permissions, content readiness and complete lobby/invite/rematch flows over the proven match service.

criteria.text: A fresh player can complete the account → friend/invite → compatible lobby → match/rematch journey.
Privacy, block/report, incompatible versions/content and unauthorized operations behave correctly.

tasks.title: Accept owned controls and browser usability
tasks.scope: Complete and exercise controls/preferences, focus/device lifecycle and accessible browser navigation with physical devices.

criteria.text: Keyboard/gamepad remapping, conflicts, calibration/prompts and multiple owned seats work without stuck or misrouted input.
Named device/browser sessions verify preferences, focus/disconnect, navigation, audio/fullscreen and quality settings; touch/mobile claims require their own observed cases.

milestones.title: Release readiness
milestones.foundation: Source publication guards, pinned runtime, source-only builds and Windows/Linux CI already exist.
milestones.goal: Ship a reproducible, documented and operationally supported release for the declared browser/device matrix.

criteria.text: Accept M1–M4 and reproduce the candidate from a clean checkout using pinned inputs/tool versions. Required CI and publication checks pass; distributed source/builds and diagnostics contain no original media, generated title code or credentials.

Freeze and test the required desktop Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari and named hardware matrix. Record full-tournament soak/relaunch/save/recovery, frame times toward 60 fps with a usable documented 30 fps mode, peak memory, import time and failure behavior against budgets fixed before acceptance runs.

Verify protocol/content/rules/converter versioning, deployment/rollback, backup/restore, capacity/admission limits, privacy/data handling and release documentation. Resolve licensing/content-release questions and authorize service costs/deployment before publication; later mobile releases pass the same applicable gates.

tasks.title: Verify reproducible source-only release operations
tasks.scope: Prepare the release candidate, version compatibility, operational recovery and documented deployment/cost/licensing decisions.

criteria.text: A clean checkout produces the candidate and passes source/CI checks without proprietary content or credentials in artifacts.
Versioning, rollback, backup/restore, capacity/privacy and release/cost decisions have reviewable procedures and evidence.

tasks.title: Accept browser/device performance and release evidence
tasks.scope: Run the frozen browser/hardware matrix and full-product soak, import, input and recovery scenarios.

criteria.text: Required desktop browsers and named hardware pass the agreed frame/memory/import budgets, full-tournament sessions and recovery cases.
All milestone acceptance records and remaining supported-device limits are reviewed; no unsupported platform or unfinished feature is advertised.
